purpose: Production Simulator EC2 instance (docs/19-aws-strategy.md Phase 3, docs/24-aws-prerequisites-setup-guide.md Phase 5) -- hosts the simulated production estate so the incident system investigates something running separately from the application backend, not localhost.
security_group_rules: SSH (22) and simulator (8090) inbound, restricted to the operator's public IP at creation time -- re-authorize if that IP changes
public_ip_note: No Elastic IP attached -- this address can change on stop/start. Re-fetch before relying on it: aws ec2 describe-instances --profile ic-ec2 --region ap-south-1 --instance-ids i-07fe1fd3c1fe8ea6c --query 'Reservations[0].Instances[0].PublicIpAddress'
setup_state: Bare Ubuntu instance only, per docs/24 Phase 5 scope. Simulator app deployment (clone repo, install deps, run as a process/systemd service) is a separate follow-up step, not yet done.
cost_discipline: Stop (not just the app) when not actively testing -- EC2 bills hourly while running regardless of CPU usage. Budget alarm AI-Incident-Command-AWS ($90) already covers this account.
